metadata.title: Crypto assets clobbered after $6 billion heist - MarketWatch

content.text:
3 hours ago
Crypto assets clobbered after $6 billion heist
News of the biggest ever crypto heist and a general risk-off tone across markets has pushed bitcoin decisively below the $80,000 mark and is hitting stocks across the sector.
Bitcoin is down more than 4% to trade just above $77,000, while Ethereum is off 1.6% to about $2,220, after Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, halted all withdrawals after hackers were believed to have made off with $6.3 billion worth of assets.
Shares of Strategy, the digital asset treasury company, fell 7% in premarket action, while trading platform Robinhood Markets lost 6%.
